messages.content: I said your playlist was a cry for help. Track four is indefensible. Your move. We're fine.
Track four entered a guilty plea on its own. You can keep the phrase. I'm taking the aux and what's left of my dignity, which is track six.
You brought a spreadsheet to cards night. There's a tab called vibes. Swing back, friendly.
I brought rigor to a table that owns a deck. The vibes tab is a cry for a dealer, and you're welcome for the data. Deal, before the points unionize.
You restarted prod and called it a personality trait. I'm allowed to be mean for one sentence.
One sentence is generous. I restarted it because the runbook and I share a single brain cell, and the brain cell believes in second chances. Your sentence. Go.
That was two sentences and a confession.
Then we're even, because your 'one sentence' was a trap with a clause. I brought snacks. You can mock the restart and also eat.
Your sourdough is a hobby that hates us. The group chat is watching.
The loaf has notes of effort and revenge. I'm still bringing it, and you're still going to eat the middle, which is the only honest part of you.
Be serious. Rate it like a critic.
No critic. You asked for a jab and now you want a column. It's dense, it's yours, I ate it. The chat can screenshot that.
The green status page, one joke, then stop.
It spent the outage in a good mood. The replica did not get the memo, or the memory.
Different room. You mocked my playlist yesterday and I saved a worse one with your name on it. Go.
Dedicated spite. I'm honored and I'm stealing it, because track one is my taste and your revenge has better range than your apology.
